name: Ecosystem
security_principles: peer capability claims are untrusted until separately authorized
MCP and A2A endpoints require HTTPS
credentials are forbidden in endpoint URLs
plugin execution is not performed by the ecosystem registry
secret material remains behind existing security boundaries
tenant context and admin roles gate registry mutation

integration_strategy.registry: process-local reference implementation with stable contracts
integration_strategy.plugins: descriptor-only; execution remains behind Tool Fabric and Isolation Fabric
integration_strategy.mcp: descriptor-only; invocation remains behind Phase 5 Tool Fabric
integration_strategy.a2a: descriptor-only; cross-agent authority remains behind Trust Kernel delegation
integration_strategy.sdk: thin HTTPS request builder; no client-side authority logic
integration_strategy.integrations: vendor-neutral domain allowlist plus server-side secret references
